cached_plot_scope: Only new saved-view states.csv/summary.json/derived.json and view.json; no geometry/node-force observation or FE/HP/model call. Plot arithmetic is deferred, not executed by this authoring pass.
phase: One wrapper runs original viewer once, then cached plots in same process/window. Original geometry/math/nodal/glyph/GIF code unchanged.
qualification_policy: Complete requires actual full production and per-case same-result N-state/fresh2N passing references. Explicit partial only for actually failed new production, no new reference arg; all plots/report identify preliminary prefix. No pressure/clamp qualification.
matching_policy: First filter each saved row by exact task.targets_mm[original_target_index] == saved d, then exact (leg, original_target_index, d). Extra bisection states stay in full original view/GIF and are listed separately from unmatched original targets. No interpolation or Fy-half assumption.
dependencies: New production and reference terminal files have not been assumed present or passed. Builder has not run; no actualN/cost is invented.
authoring_checks: AST parse and compile all5 Python files without executing code
original viewer/launcher full raw SHA equality
whole original viewer AST equality including geometry/nodal computations
cached plot import closure contains no hf_eval or observer API
static_revision: Root/peer requested original-task-target-only cached comparison and final output-hash resource check. Original viewer/launcher/builder unchanged. No execution or new test.
whole_phase_resource_scope: Final output hashing completes before final helper180/RSS check and elapsed/peak receipt values; a new final resource failure sets failed and exits nonzero, while earlier exceptions retain their cause.
